verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents automatic collection of compliance data through auditor-vetted native integrations, where that data "automatically satisfies evidence requests" (thoropass-docs-35, thoropass-docs-67, thoropass-docs-75). Monitors check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP (thoropass-docs-54), and monitors and integrations refresh data "up to daily or ad-hoc", which covers the scheduled-collection core (thoropass-docs-74). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that collected artifacts are timestamped, documentation that machine-gathered artifacts replace screenshots/CSV uploads, detail on which connected systems produce which evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
